title: EIP-8237: Independent CL/EL Sync
description: Enables independent consensus and execution layer synchronization by replacing execution_requests_root with an accumulator hash.
author: M. Kalinin <noblesse.knight@gmail.com>, Potuz (@potuz), Toni Wahrstätter (@nerolation)
laymanDescription: Once execution payloads travel separately from beacon blocks, a consensus client syncing a long range still has to download every payload just to confirm the two agree. This proposal replaces that check with a running hash chained across blocks, verifiable in one pass after the execution layer catches up.
benefits: Consensus clients can range sync without downloading execution payloads at all
Removes execution engine round trips from sync, cutting both bandwidth and latency
Each layer verifies the same commitment chain independently, so either side catches drift
tradeoffs: Uses plain SHA256 rather than SSZ hashing, so the accumulator is not Merkle-provable
Payload verification is deferred, detected only once the execution layer catches up
The execution layer must maintain and check a commitment it has no other use for
